//: Declaration-only build for design-sync's .d.ts prop extraction. The converter's dts.mjs reads a real, already-emitted .d.ts tree (package.json `types`) rather than inferring types from .tsx source -- with no dist/ build in this repo, that tree doesn't otherwise exist, so every component's props silently stub to `[key: string]: unknown`. This tsconfig emits a real one from components/ui + components/icon into .design-sync/.cache/dts-types (gitignored, regenerated by cfg.buildCmd), matching the `types` field added to package.json.
